original_target.title: Deterministic identity testing for arithmetic circuits

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original unconditional deterministic Turing bit-polynomial white-box PIT for all rational arithmetic circuits with unary gate-degree promise. Shpilka–Tal Theorem1.1 only handles depth4 powering circuits with degree/fanin relation d=Omega(r^2); Theorem1.2 has stronger structure/degree conditions. Restricted formulas, nonassociative algebras and conditional hardness derandomization do not imply the target general circuit algorithm. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
